spec_match.rationale: Every probe exercises the exact :navigation-source surface (CSS.supports selector(), matches(), querySelector(), stylesheet parse survival) plus the NavigateEvent.sourceElement property the spec names as what the pseudo-class reflects; the builder generates the spec's own compound shapes (a:navigation-source .thumb, form:navigation-source .submit).

interactive.rationale: Probes run live on load with a re-run button, and the compound-selector builder rebuilds and re-tests through CSS.supports on every input.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises five exact-surface probes plus a compound-selector builder; the page delivers exactly those.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the SyntaxError-on-unsupported behaviour of matches()/querySelector as a probe in its own right, the whole-rule parse drop, the mixed pass/fail (Navigation API present, selector absent), and unparseable builder input.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6327898878377984 and the css-navigation-1 #navigation-source-pseudo-class anchor.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the same five contracts (selector supported, compound parses, matches doesn't throw, null at rest, rule survives, reflected property) and executed on the /conformance/ route at 1 pass / 5 fail / 0 blocked on Chromium 141 — the honest pre-156 shape with no runner errors.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified in headless Chromium 141 (CLI screenshots desktop+mobile, dump-dom, console clean; Playwright-scripted interaction confirmed rerun + builder update to form:navigation-source .submit). chrome-devtools-mcp was not available in this environment, and the supported branch (probes passing) needs a Chrome 156/Canary run with --enable-blink-features=NavigationSourcePseudoClass, which this Chromium 141 cannot provide even flagged.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads /public/demo-telemetry.js and asserts per-probe results (probe-supports … probe-reflection) and every builder run with the selector and support outcome.

design_system.rationale: All colours are CSS variables, buttons that restyle background also set color, verdict states use accent-emerald/accent-rose on light grounds (AA), no static-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/selects/inputs with visible labels, code blocks focusable (tabindex=0), probe summary and builder verdict in aria-live outputs, keyboard operability confirmed via scripted Tab/Enter on the sibling page using identical patterns.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Measured at 360×740 DPR3 touch and 1280×800: documentElement.scrollWidth == 360 (zero page overflow, badCount 0 at element level), controls ≥44px, probe grid collapses to one column; screenshots read cleanly on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported branch on Chrome 156 / Canary with NavigationSourcePseudoClass enabled
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 in the build environment cannot enable the flag (it predates the feature), so every probe's true branch — supports() true, matches() returning false without throwing, querySelector null, 1 surviving rule — is asserted but unobserved. Run the page and the conformance route in Chrome Canary ≥156 (or --enable-blink-features=NavigationSourcePseudoClass once the flag exists in an available build) and confirm the summary flips to the supported wording.

guidanceConsulted.query: progressive enhancement unsupported CSS selector fallback feature detection
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Feature-detect exact CSS surfaces and degrade with explicit, honest states rather than hiding failures.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every probe reports its false/throwing result verbatim with an 'unsupported here' label and exact enable steps (chrome://flags id and --enable-blink-features=NavigationSourcePseudoClass) instead of a bare upgrade banner.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible loading progress status announcements live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async/derived status through live regions and keep custom output keyboard-reachable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probe summary and builder verdict are <output aria-live="polite">; code samples carry tabindex=0 for keyboard scroll access.

summary: Five honest exact-surface probes plus a compound builder. On Chromium 141 the page correctly reports 1/5 supported (only the reflected NavigateEvent.sourceElement property), with clean console and zero page-level overflow on both device classes; the pending work is observing the supported branch on a ≥156 build.
